commits.subject: feat(notes): keep staff notes apart from a customer's request
commits.body: Staff had been typing internal notes into the customer's request text, which customers could then read in their portal. Notes are now separate entries that only staff see. A one-off cleanup moved existing notes out of 48 requests. The cleanup keeps every moved sentence verbatim and
